Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Banking and Finance Republic Financial Holdings Limited announces Karen Yip Chuck as Group President Nigel Baptiste retires Source : Jessie Agbakpo 10 November 2026 2:47pm ▶ Listen to this article Audio By Carbonatix
Republic Financial Holdings Limited (RFHL) has announced a historic leadership transition following the retirement of Nigel Baptiste as Group President and Chief Executive Officer of RFHL and Managing Director of Republic Bank Limited, with his last day being November 13, 2026.
Persuant to Nigel Baptiste’s retirement, Republic Financial Holdings Limited has appointed Karen Yip Chuck to both roles, effective November 14, 2026.
Baptiste retires after a distinguished career spanning more than three decades with the Republic Group, including the last ten years at its helm. He originally retired on May 10, 2026, after agreeing to stay on with the organisation through the end of its financial year.
During his decade of executive stewardship, the Group doubled its asset base and expanded its operational footprint across sixteen territories. Under his leadership, RFHL also significantly scaled its corporate social responsibility and community development initiatives across the regions it serves.
Reflecting on Baptiste’s tenure, Yashmid Karamath, Chairman of Republic Financial Holdings Limited, highlighted the strength of the institution’s leadership pipeline.
"For over thirty years, and especially over the last decade as Group President and CEO, Nigel Baptiste has been a guiding force for the Republic Group," the Chairman stated.
"While our financial milestones, doubling our assets and expanding across sixteen countries, speak to his strategic acumen, Nigel’s true legacy lies in his unwavering investment in our people and our communities. By mentoring and empowering those around him, he has nurtured a brilliant new generation of leaders, continuing our proud, historic tradition of entrusting the Group's future to exceptional hands. We extend our deepest gratitude to Nigel and wish him boundless joy and fulfillment in his retirement."
Ms. Yip Chuck makes history as the first woman appointed to lead the Republic Group.
She is a banker with 36 years of service at Republic Bank and a pivotal member of the Executive Leadership Team and she brings an extensive record of strategic growth, institutional strengthening, and long term sustainability to the role.
Throughout her tenure, Yip Chuck strengthened and aligned the Bank’s operational risk framework with global standards, reinforcing world-class corporate governance.
She also was responsible for consistently championing forward-thinking products to meet evolving client needs and served as a key catalyst for regional growth by expanding corporate banking relationships across the Caribbean, driving economic diversification through expert advisory support.
"Our strength has always come from our people and our shared commitment to the communities we serve," said incoming Group President and CEO Karen Yip Chuck.
"I am deeply honoured to accept the baton from Nigel and to build upon the remarkable foundation he has laid. Throughout my thirty- six years with Republic, I have lived by the belief that the Bank will only thrive when its people thrive. As we enter this next chapter of growth, my focus remains steadfast: empowering our teams, deepening our client relationships, and delivering enduring value for our employees, shareholders, customers, and communities."
Commenting on Ms. Yip Chuck’s appointment, the Chairman added: "Karen steps forward with unwavering dedication, sound judgment, commercial acumen, strong governance credentials and a deep understanding of the diverse markets in which we operate.”
“Her proven record of performance and people-centred leadership gives the Board every confidence that she will strengthen our legacy and guide the Republic Group seamlessly into the future. Over a distinguished 36-year career with us, and as a cornerstone of our Executive Leadership Team, Karen has already helped architect the operational strength and vibrant culture we share today. What is inspiring about Karen is her philosophy on leadership. She has spent three decades championing the belief that our institution only thrives when our people thrive. Her faith in the potential of this team is absolute, and because she knows our people, our values, and our strategy inside and out, we move forward with confidence,” he noted.
